parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the wall cabinet, made of plywood panels joined together to form the enclosure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal storage space, ensuring stability and durability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move; it serves as the stationary base to which the door and other components are attached.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the front of the cabinet frame, typically finished with veneer or paint and equipped with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior by opening and closing, protecting stored items from dust and maintaining a clean appearance.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges, allowing it to swing open and closed smoothly.
